description: Designed and developed isolated environments for premium Zoho CRM customers, boosting system availability, security, and performance, leading to higher customer satisfaction and revenue growth.
Optimized microservices architecture using Apache Kafka for inter-service communication, reducing latency by 10% and enhancing overall API response times.
Resolved customer-reported issues proactively, driving a 25% reduction in support tickets and elevating the overall user experience.
Built and scaled RESTful APIs with Java Spring, processing over 2 million daily requests with 99.99% uptime and an average response time of less than 200 milliseconds.
Led end-to-end development and deployment of new features, improving system efficiency and accelerating product delivery.
Gained hands-on experience with internal tools and frameworks, and built a mini project to apply the concepts learned.
Collaborated with the team and improved understanding of system design, performance optimization, and debugging through practical exposure.
Developed and contributed to a stock market analytics dashboard using React JS, enhancing data visualization and user experience.
Collaborated with the development team to ensure seamless integration of UI components, improving functionality and performance.
Designed and developed several client-side applications with React JS, focusing on responsive and intuitive interfaces.
Integrated headless CMS solutions using STRAPI, streamlining content management and enhancing backend flexibility.
Developed a Progressive Web App (PWA) from scratch using React JS and Node JS, enhancing the mobile experience for users.
Worked on backend services using Node JS, optimizing server-side logic for scalability and performance.
Built and launched the Admin Panel from scratch using React JS, enabling efficient management of the platform.
Developed the backend API v2 with Node JS, ensuring data consistency, scalability, and enhanced application performance.
